verdict.rationale: The IRS documents machine channels for a subset of functions. IRIS offers an Application-to-Application (A2A) intake alongside its Taxpayer Portal/UI for information returns, and MeF provides XML system-to-system e-filing, but both are credential-gated. Many UI functions have no documented API equivalent: the EIN online assistant, Online Account signed forms such as the 83(b) election behind ID.me liveness, and payments. Probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API parity for EIN application, Online Account/signed forms, payments, transcripts and IP PIN; a public, ungated API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: receives information through two intake channels: IRIS Taxpayer Portal/UI and IRIS Application to Application (A2A)
MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
